caption:
🔥 बॉक्स ऑफिस पर रच दिया गया है नया इतिहास! 🎬
निदेशक नितेश तिवारी की फिल्म Ramayana Part 1 ने दुनियाभर में 20 दिनों में 1766.45 करोड़ रुपये का तगड़ा कलेक्शन कर लिया है। 💥
इस फिल्म ने Allu Arjun की Pushpa 2 को 1.60 करोड़ से पीछे छोड़ दिया है और ग्लोबल लेवल पर चौथी सबसे ज्यादा कमाई करने वाली भारतीय फिल्म बन गई है। 📈
इस आंकड़े में 579 करोड़ रुपये की ओवरसीज कमाई भी शामिल है और फिल्म ने 1000 करोड़ India net का आंकड़ा भी पार कर लिया है। 🌍
अब Ramayana को Baahubali 2 से आगे निकलने के लिए सिर्फ 21.61 करोड़ रुपये की जरूरत है, जबकि Dangal से दूरी 303.85 करोड़ रुपये की है। 🤔
क्या यह फिल्म Baahubali 2 को पछाड़कर तीसरा स्थान हासिल कर पाएगी? 🍿

#Ramayana #CineChaska #BollywoodNews #BoxOffice #RanbirKapoor #Yash #Pushpa2

ctx.title: Ramayana Worldwide Box Office: Countdown To Rewrite The History Of Indian Cinema Begins – Beats Pushpa 2, 22 Crore Away From 3rd Highest Grosser!
ctx.summary:
Ramayana has surpassed lifetime collection of Pushpa 2 and is 22 crore away from the third highest grosser of Indian Cinema - worldwide box office report! 
 The post  Ramayana Worldwide Box Office: Countdown To Rewrite The History Of Indian Cinema Begins – Beats Pushpa 2, 22 Crore Away From 3rd Highest Grosser!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The countdown to rewrite the all-time global box office history of Indian cinema has officially begun! Director Nitesh Tiwari’s mythological epic Ramayana: Part 1, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi, has stormed to a huge 1766.45 crore gross worldwide at the end of 20 days!
Even more remarkably, Ramayana has just overtaken Allu Arjun’s Pushpa 2: The Rule by 1.60 crore to claim the fourth spot among the highest-grossing Indian films of all time globally! Now, Ramayana sits just 21.61 crore away from overtaking SS Rajamouli’s Baahubali 2: The Conclusion for the third spot, while Nitesh Tiwari’s own all-time topper Dangal remains 303.85 crore away!
Powered by crossing the landmark 1000 crore India net milestone alongside record-shattering North American and international collections, Ramayana’s 1766.45 crore worldwide gross includes a gross collection of 579 crore overseas!
Check out the breakdown of the film at the box office after 20 days.
Edging ahead of Pushpa 2 by 1.60 crore to claim fourth spot in the list of the highest-grossing Indian films of all time globally, Ramayana now needs only 21.61 crore to pass Baahubali 2, 84.37 crore to catch Dhurandhar 2, and 303.85 crore to topple Dangal .
